<reason>A won a competitive debate by making the instrument the vote: a mean-based retirement gate cannot be aimed, so indexing charges unequal lives the same extra years. B’s arithmetic, tax-treadmill, and carve-out replies stayed live, but two clipped speeches and the concession that extra months land at 67 left the inequality objection standing. A’s pressure and gate-versus-dial weighing made the choice clearer.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s Q1/Q2 on whose life expectancy and when extra months actually fall, then converting B’s admission that they land at 67 into a knock: phasing is notice, not a shift of burden off worn-out late-career workers.</best_rebuttal>
